bio_text: Ashia is a physicist-turned-founder building SymbyAI, an AI-powered operating system for scientific discovery. After struggling with archaic research workflows at Fermilab, she recognized that 85% of research funding is wasted on low-quality studies and founded SymbyAI to automate experimental replication and validation at scale. She combines scientific rigor with AI innovation to help researchers spend less time fighting paperwork and more time testing hypotheses.
